# Glow Guy Detailing

Slogan: Your Car. Our Reputation.

> Mobile car detailing in the Niagara Region, Hamilton and Greater Toronto Area (GTA), Ontario, Canada. We come to the client's home or office. Interior detailing and full details. Exact price by vehicle size, confirmed in writing before the appointment.

## Packages (sedan prices; SUV/truck and 3-row/large are higher — see the site calculator)

- Winter Salt Rescue: from $155 (Nov–Apr) — hot-water extraction of road salt from carpets and mats, interior vacuum and wipe-down, 1.5–2 hours.
- Interior Reset: $210 — full vacuum, hot-water extraction of seats and carpets, salt and stain treatment, dash/console/vents, interior glass, 2–3 hours.
- Full Glow: $280 — everything in Interior Reset plus foam hand wash, wheels and tires, door jambs, exterior glass, spray sealant, 3–4 hours.
- Showroom + Sealant: $380 — everything in Full Glow plus clay-bar decontamination, 12-month sealant, engine-bay detail, 5–6 hours.
- Add-ons: pet hair +$70, engine bay $90, clay bar +$60, odour removal +$80, leather conditioning +$70.

## How booking works

1. Customer picks a package and vehicle size in the website calculator, or tells us the vehicle and package by phone, text, Instagram DM or Facebook Messenger. Prices are fixed by package and vehicle size — no photo estimate is needed.
2. They receive that exact price confirmed in writing, usually within one business hour.
3. We detail at their home or office on the chosen day.

## Service area

St. Catharines, Niagara Falls, Welland, Hamilton, Stoney Creek, Grimsby, Niagara-on-the-Lake, Thorold, Fonthill, Burlington, Oakville, Mississauga, Brampton, Toronto, Vaughan, Markham, Richmond Hill (Ontario, Canada). Open 7 days a week, 8:00–20:00.
